rules: a kurl note row is reported as kurl:note:{id}, a blog post row as kurl:post:{id}, a remote row by its uri; a remote row without a uri is not reported
the server takes kurl:(note|post):{id} with id a decimal from 1 to 9223372036854775807 without leading zeros, lowercase only; anything else starting kurl: is dropped
the server takes an http or https uri with a host up to 2048 characters; anything else is dropped
on 홈 최신 a row counts as seen the moment any part of it is on screen while the app is in front, with no time floor
on 둘러보기 다른 서버 a row counts once at least half of it has stayed on screen for 1 second while the app is in front
팔로잉 and 인기 do not report rows
dwell is sent only for remote uris, as the running total once it reaches 1 second, capped at 10 minutes; kurl keys never carry dwell

홈 최신 and the 맞춤 mixed into it are asked with seen=hide and the device header; 둘러보기 맞춤 is asked with the device header and without seen=hide; 팔로잉 and 인기 need neither, since they neither record nor hide what was seen
the server leaves a kurl note or post out of 홈 최신 when the same viewer has a record of it received before the scroll's asOf (stored or still buffered), unless a signed-in viewer wrote it

hiding is on for a first page with seen=hide, or any h cursor (even malformed, even without seen=hide); an old .

cursor never hides; tabs other than latest never hide
a member and a device are different viewers; one never hides for the other
iOS only: the cached first page is drawn without keys seen less than 14 days ago, except my own
a pull sends the pending seen batch first, then asks both first pages again
a pull ends in exactly one notice: newRows, nothingNew, caughtUp or failed
after a pull a list that failed keeps the rows it had; the rows now laid out (home-mix rules) are compared by key with the rows laid out before
any new key is newRows, even when one of the two lists failed: the new rows are the result
no new key and either list failed is failed; that includes my feed coming back empty while 맞춤 failed
no new key, nothing failed and nothing laid out is caughtUp; otherwise nothingNew

format.accepted: a string a client sends → as local (kind, itemId as a decimal string), remote, or dropped
format.dwell: running total in ms for a key → sentMs, or null when nothing is sent
format.requests: which requests carry seen=hide, and whether the X-Kurl-Device header is required or not needed (sending it anyway does no harm)
format.hide: viewer, request (tab, seenHide, cursor: none|h|h-malformed|old), item (ref kind:id, authorId), record (viewer, item, receivedBeforeAsOf, in: db|buffer) → shown
format.cache: iOS cached first page: seenSecondsAgo (null if never), authorIsMe → leftOut
format.pull: before (own, remote, ownDone as laid out by home-mix rules), own and remote results → notice; own/remote items use the home-mix item format
format.currentlyDiffers: what a platform's code did when this version was made (iOS 521f1ca, web 6a3ff0ad) where it disagrees; informational, not an answer
